title: Helm values schema for Keycloak clients (root map)
description: Root object is a map of Keycloak clients keyed by clientId. Each entry may define helper fields and/or rawValues overrides.

subdomain.description: If set, used to build rootUrl/baseUrl/redirectUris/webOrigins. Defaults to the clientId key.

redirectPath.description: If set, appended to redirectUris URL. Defaults to '/*'.

additionalRedirectPaths.description: Optional extra paths (appended to the computed rootUrl) to register as additional redirect URIs alongside the primary redirectPath.

additionalRedirectUris.description: Optional redirect URIs on another host of the platform domain, for a client that logs people in on more than one host (the edge client: the Portal host and the apex, ADR-N-019). Each entry renders as https://{subdomain}.{domain}{path}; an empty subdomain is the apex.

subdomain.description: Subdomain of the platform domain; empty for the apex.

path.description: Path appended to the host, e.g. /apps/*.

includePort443Variant.description: If true, mirror every computed redirect URI with an explicit `:443` variant. Use for clients whose upstream app emits the default HTTPS port verbatim in the OAuth2 `redirect_uri` (e.g. Apache NiFi 2.x). Off by default.

name.description: Human-friendly client name. Defaults to the clientId key.

description.description: Client description. Defaults to empty string.

rawValues.description: Free-form overrides merged into the computed client defaults using mergeOverwrite.

serviceAccountClientRoles.description: Client roles granted to this client's service account user (service-account-{clientId}). Keycloak maps a client role onto the user, never onto the client, so a client that needs an Admin API role declares it here. Keyed by the client that owns the role, e.g. realm-management.
